1) Who wrote 'Romeo and Juliet'?
(A) Charles Dickens
(B) William Shakespeare
(C) Jane Austen
(D) Mark Twain

2) How many continents are there?
(A) 5
(B) 6
(C) 7
(D) 8

3) What is the boiling point of water at sea level?
(A) 90 °C
(B) 100 °C
(C) 110 °C
(D) 120 °C

4) Which protocol is used to send e-mail?
(A) FTP
(B) SMTP
(C) HTTP
(D) SSH

5) What is the past tense of 'go'?
(A) goed
(B) gone
(C) went
(D) going

6) Which data structure works on the LIFO principle?
(A) queue
(B) stack
(C) tree
(D) graph

7) What is 7 × 8?
(A) 54
(B) 56
(C) 58
(D) 64

8) Which ocean lies between Europe and North America?
(A) Pacific
(B) Indian
(C) Atlantic
(D) Arctic

Answer key: 1-B 2-C 3-B 4-B 5-C 6-B 7-B 8-C
